intervention_scopes: A direct outcome channel changes IV without changing the first stage.
A more predictive instrument containing the latent disturbance remains invalid.
Recompute structural residual meat at the finite two-step estimate; it differs from the stipulated preliminary meat.
Known population versus feasible preliminary weighting changes a finite J decision, without changing the asymptotic theorem.
Change instrument units and mix instruments: transformed inverse weight preserves the result while a naive fixed weight does not.
Add one genuinely independent valid moment to a rank-deficient system; redundant row count alone fails.
Retain versus discard off-diagonal score covariance; inverse marginal variances are not efficient weights.
A two-coefficient three-moment correlated system checks the matrix, not only scalar, efficiency identity.
Moment violations parallel to the regressor span shift the fitted target without creating a J residual.
Move a nonlinear sample moment to a parameter boundary and enlarge a signed domain; global and local conditions change separately.
Scale first-stage relevance with sample size; standardized-score algebra distinguishes shrinking and nonshrinking errors.
Reduce a critical value through the quadratic minimum, and remove projected relevance: interval, singleton, empty and all-real sets are explicitly distinguished.
Introduce defiers and, separately, a direct encouragement effect; the Wald numerator changes through different causal assumptions.
Change encouragement frequency, then an unobserved never-treated potential outcome: ATT mixture and ATE identification differ from LATE.
